title: Dodge the Blocks 3D Pixels
description: A fast-paced 3D pixel dodge game where you avoid falling blocks and collect power-ups.
how_to_play:
1. Press Enter to start the game.
2. Use A / D or Left / Right arrows to move.
3. Avoid falling blocks to survive as long as possible.
4. Collect power-ups like shield, slow, shrink, and score multipliers.
5. Try to get the highest score on the leaderboard!

Tips:
- Keep moving to avoid clusters of blocks.
- Use power-ups wisely.
- Stay focused and react quickly.
